title: A Pattern Holds Steady Long Enough to Read
body:
The signal you have been tracking is neither fading nor intensifying right now — it is simply staying visible. This is the part of the cycle where the pattern is easiest to study calmly, without the pressure of a closing window.
Action: Use this steadier stretch to test your read against real outcomes rather than reacting to every new data point.
